sentences.text: 5.Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that a settlement-agreement dated 4.8.2022 has been drawn between the parties, a copy of which has been annexed as Annexue No. 4 to this application.

6.Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that applicant No. 1 and opposite party No.
2 have restored their relationship and are living together as husband and wife and leading a happy married life.
7.Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that in view of the compromise made between the parties, the entire proceedings be quashed.

8.Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has also appeared and has filed an affidavit and in paragraph-6, the said compromise has been acknowledged and the factum of applicant No. 1 and opposite party No. 2, living together and leading a happy married life has also been reiterated in paragraph-6 of the affidavit and she does not want to further pursue the case and has no objection, if the entire proceedings are quashed.
